surface_verification.justification: backend CLI/library mechanics only (loop_state.json state machine, fencing, atomic claim) -- no startable web/dev-server/CLI surface of its own to browser-verify; verification is the unit + real-process/real-git integration suite itself (F0).

behaviors.behavior: the 9-state edge table matches the spec exactly (legal/illegal for every from/to pair)
`mark`'s forced override crosses any real edge but still rejects an unknown state name
ACTIVE/RESUMABLE/TERMINAL partition every state with none left over
reconcile dispatch: sub_iterate -> lease-based reconcile; section/unknown kind -> untouched legacy reconcile
lease-based reconcile: never-leased/expired claimed-or-running unit resets to pending without bumping attempt; a live lease is left untouched; `merging` is never touched

cmd_init resume/reinit fix (gated kind==sub_iterate): ACTIVE reconciled+mutates, RESUMABLE reports resumed without mutating, all-TERMINAL resumes pending:0 not reinit, genuinely empty list still reinits
a unit stuck at the pre-R4 legacy status "in_progress" is reconciled via the untouched legacy path (alone or alongside an ACTIVE unit), never silently reported resumed-with-nothing-pending
cmd_finalize refuses while any unit sits outside TERMINAL, and summarizes merged/failed/held counts once all units are terminal
cmd_record's status remap: never-claimed row passes through unchanged; claimed row maps complete->built, else->failed; kind==section never remapped even with attempt_id present

cmd_record's fencing gate: never-claimed unit skips the check; claimed unit without --attempt-id rejected; stale token rejected AND parked; matching token proceeds -- including the write-lock target-transition-legality re-check (code-review TOCTOU fix)
fencing primitives: SHA format validation, attempt-token match/mismatch/absence, unit-row lookup exact-then-case-fold
canonical state-root path helpers (runs_dir_for, rejected_payload_path, handoff_dir_for) are state-root-relative, never cwd-relative
rejected_payload_path safely contains a malicious --attempt-id (path separators, .., absolute paths, embedded NUL) inside its intended directory, never escaping it
behaviors.evidence: Step 3.8 confidence-calibration probe (this run, run_id iterate-2026-09-22-r4-state-mechanics): 6/6 malicious attempt_id values contained, 0 findings

behaviors.behavior: atomic batch claim (cmd_next_batch): claims min(max_parallel, ready_set) atomically; rejects invalid --max-parallel/non-sub_iterate kind; reports done/stalled/LockTimeout correctly; claims a unit whose dependency ancestry verifies

dependency ancestry assert: no-deps always ready; missing base/merged_commit/invalid SHA fail closed; ancestor confirmed without or after one fetch retry; still-absent leaves the unit pending for next round rather than failing the batch

single-writer fencing on claim: first claim never bumps attempt; a reclaim bumps attempt exactly once on the NEXT claim; a claim writes an initial lease so the unit is never read as never-leased before its runner's first heartbeat (code-review fix)
cmd_release: returns a launch-failed unit to pending without bumping attempt; fails it once max_attempts exhausted; rejects a stale token/non-claimed unit/unknown unit id
mark-running/mark-merged: identity-checked promotion with a matching token; stale token rejected; illegal source state rejected; merge commit format-validated before any write

mark, the audited operator override: crosses any forced edge with an audit trail; rejects unknown status; running/merging require --force+--confirm-no-task-running; --status merged requires a valid --merged-commit AND fresh-fetch-verified ancestor AND --campaign-worktree (code-review fix), never falling back to the process cwd
reason/operator text sanitization: control characters and over-length values rejected; boundary (exactly 500 vs 501 chars, and 500 multi-byte characters) empirically probed
behaviors.evidence: shared/tests/test_loop_mark.py::TestSanitizeText (4 tests) PASSED + Step 3.8 confidence-calibration probe (this run): 500 accepted, 501 rejected, 500 multi-byte accepted

behaviors.behavior: loop_state.json v1 files degrade safely: cmd_next still works, honors R1-vintage depends_on, tolerates missing attempt_id/lease fields, reports done the same as before

check_unit_attempt.py (the runner's pre-push fencing check): matching token allows; stale token blocks with exit 5; missing unit/state file blocks with exit 1; a never-claimed unit with no attempt_id field blocks
kind==section full behavioral regression (work item 12): init -> next -> record -> crash -> init-resume -> finalize returns every value and status unchanged from pre-R4 behavior

kind==section lease-unaware legacy reconcile (retargeted verbatim from autonomous_loop.py): live/stale lease still resets to pending, no-lease-fields falls through to the old salvage logic unchanged, a result.json-complete unit is reconciled regardless of any lease field
N real OS processes racing a real file lock never double-claim the same unit
a lease that expired before a wave boundary is reclaimed via a real init subprocess call, not a mock
a dependency whose merge commit is unmergeable against a real git repo leaves the dependent unit pending for the next batch, rather than blocking or failing the whole batch
